alex: @jon thanks. @maya @sre-oncall are you around? I'm going to pull logs now.

```text
2026-03-18T14:02:03Z ERROR test_matrix: hung after 9m 12s
```

maya: I can take a look — pulling the previous green run diff and env.

alex: good call. @jon can you rebase onto main and push? if not, we can rerun the failing job to check for flakiness.

deploy-bot: Rerun requested by alex -> https://ci.internal/retry/6678901234 (new run id: 6678901234.2)

maya: if the rerun fails I can start a bisect between green run 6678800000 and this merge.
priya: :thumbsup: thanks. @sre-oncall can you monitor for broader regressions and capture kernel traces if the rerun fails?
sre-oncall: On it — I'll grab traces and STAGE logs, and open an incident if the rerun fails consistently. tagging owners: @jon @alex @maya.
alex: assigning to infra rotation for bisect if needed. For now I'll watch the rerun and post updates here.
